Actúa como un Desarrollador Full-Stack experto en Python y Streamlit. Necesito que generes el código completo para una aplicación web de fidelización y canje de premios para la empresa "Prolub SA - GULF".

1. Estilo y Diseño (UI/UX):

Temática: Estilo "Mundial 2026" (fútbol, dinámico, moderno).

Colores: Usa una paleta que combine la temática del mundial con los colores corporativos de Gulf (Naranja, Azul, Blanco).

Branding: Debe tener un encabezado llamativo con el logo de "Prolub SA - GULF".

2. Gestión de Datos (Simulación de Archivos CSV):

El código debe generar y usar internamente 3 DataFrames (simulando 3 archivos CSV):

Clientes_y_Contrasena.csv: Columnas [Tipo de cliente, Punto de venta, contraseña]. (Llenar con datos de ejemplo: algunos tipo 'Pareto' y otros 'Normal').

Puntos_Clientes.csv: Columnas [Punto de venta, PuntosDisponibles].

Premios.csv: Columnas [NombrePremio, Descripcion, PuntosCostoPareto, PuntosCostoNormal, ImagenURL].

3. Lógica de Negocio (Pareto vs Normal):

Validación: Al hacer login con Punto de venta y contraseña, el sistema debe identificar automáticamente el Tipo de cliente (Pareto o Normal).

Visualización de Precios:

Si el cliente es Pareto, el catálogo debe mostrar el precio de la columna PuntosCostoPareto.

Si el cliente es Normal, debe mostrar el precio de PuntosCostoNormal.

Actualización: Los puntos disponibles se leen del archivo Puntos_Clientes.csv.

4. Flujo de la Tienda:

Login: Dropdown para seleccionar "Punto de venta" y campo de texto para contraseña.

Dashboard: Mostrar en grande: "Bienvenido [Punto de venta] - Tienes [X] Puntos Disponibles".

Catálogo: Cuadrícula con los premios. Al seleccionar uno, pedir "Cantidad".

Validación de Compra: Calcular CostoTotal = PrecioSegúnTipoCliente * Cantidad. Si el usuario tiene puntos suficientes, permitir la compra; si no, mostrar error.

5. Checkout y Notificación:

Formulario obligatorio tras la validación: Dirección, Persona que recibe, Ciudad, Teléfono.

Al confirmar, mostrar mensaje de éxito y simular en consola o pantalla el envío de un correo con los detalles a: agallego@gulfcolombia.com y asismercadeo@gulfcolombia.com.

Agrega a este codigo una manera de actualizar la lista de clientes, puntos y premios

const parseClientsFromCSV = (): { clients: Client[], points: ClientPoints[] } => {
  const lines = RAW_CLIENTS_CSV.trim().split('\n');
  const clients: Client[] = [];
  const points: ClientPoints[] = [];
  
  // Skip header if it exists
  const startIndex = lines[0].startsWith('Tipo de cliente') ? 1 : 0;

  for (let i = startIndex; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const line = lines[i].trim();
    if (!line) continue;
    
    const parts = line.split(';');
    if (parts.length >= 3) {
      const type = parts[0].trim() as ClientType;
      const pointOfSale = parts[1].trim();
      const password = parts[2].trim();
      
      if (pointOfSale && password) {
        clients.push({
          id: `c_${i}`,
          pointOfSale,
          password,
          type
        });
        
        points.push({
          pointOfSale,
          points: DEFAULT_POINTS
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return { clients, points };
};

const { clients: parsedClients, points: parsedPoints } = parseClientsFromCSV();

// Helper to load/save from localStorage
export const getDatabase = (): Database => {
  const stored = localStorage.getItem(DB_KEY);
  if (!stored) {
    localStorage.setItem(DB_KEY, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_DATA));
    return INITIAL_DATA;
  }
  return JSON.parse(stored);
};

export const saveDatabase = (data: Database) => {
  localStorage.setItem(DB_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
};

export const resetDatabase = (): Database => {
  localStorage.removeItem(DB_KEY);
  return getDatabase();
};

export const updateClientPoints = (pointOfSale: string, newPoints: number) => {
  const db = getDatabase();
  const index = db.points.findIndex(p => p.pointOfSale === pointOfSale);
  if (index !== -1) {
    db.points[index].points = newPoints;
    saveDatabase(db);
  }
};

export const deductPoints = (pointOfSale: string, amount: number): boolean => {
  const db = getDatabase();
  const clientPoints = db.points.find(p => p.pointOfSale === pointOfSale);
  
  if (clientPoints && clientPoints.points >= amount) {
    clientPoints.points -= amount;
    saveDatabase(db);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
};

export const getClients = () => getDatabase().clients;
export const getPoints = (pointOfSale: string) => getDatabase().points.find(p => p.pointOfSale === pointOfSale)?.points || 0;
export const getRewards = () => getDatabase().rewards;

// Función para normalizar claves de búsqueda
// Elimina tildes, ñ (la vuelve N o elimina según caso para matching fuzzy), y caracteres no alfanuméricos.
// Esto permite que "NIÑO" haga match con "NI O" o "NI O" con "NIO".
const normalizeKey = (str: string) => {
  return str.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '');
};

const parseDataFromCSVs = (): { clients: Client[], points: ClientPoints[] } => {
  const clientsLines = RAW_CLIENTS_CSV.trim().split('\n');
  const pointsLines = RAW_POINTS_CSV.trim().split('\n');
  
  const clients: Client[] = [];
  const pointsMap = new Map<string, number>();

  // 1. Parsear Puntos y guardar en mapa con clave normalizada
  const pointsStart = pointsLines[0].startsWith('Punto de venta') ? 1 : 0;
  for (let i = pointsStart; i < pointsLines.length; i++) {
    const line = pointsLines[i].trim();
    if (!line) continue;
    const parts = line.split(';');
    if (parts.length >= 2) {
      const posName = parts[0].trim();
      const pts = parseInt(parts[1].trim()) || 0;
      // Guardamos usando la clave normalizada para tolerar fallos de encoding
      pointsMap.set(normalizeKey(posName), pts);
    }
  }

  // 2. Parsear Clientes y buscar sus puntos
  const clientsStart = clientsLines[0].startsWith('Tipo de cliente') ? 1 : 0;
  const points: ClientPoints[] = [];

  for (let i = clientsStart; i < clientsLines.length; i++) {
    const line = clientsLines[i].trim();
    if (!line) continue;
    
    const parts = line.split(';');
    if (parts.length >= 3) {
      const type = parts[0].trim() as ClientType;
      const pointOfSale = parts[1].trim();
      const password = parts[2].trim();
      
      if (pointOfSale && password) {
        clients.push({
          id: `c_${i}`,
          pointOfSale,
          password,
          type
        });
        
        // Buscar puntos usando normalización
        const normalizedPOS = normalizeKey(pointOfSale);
        const pts = pointsMap.get(normalizedPOS);

        points.push({
          pointOfSale,
          points: pts !== undefined ? pts : DEFAULT_POINTS
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return { clients, points };
};

// Helper to load/save from localStorage
export const getDatabase = (): Database => {
  const stored = localStorage.getItem(DB_KEY);
  if (!stored) {
    localStorage.setItem(DB_KEY, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_DATA));
    return INITIAL_DATA;
  }
  return JSON.parse(stored);
};

export const saveDatabase = (data: Database) => {
  localStorage.setItem(DB_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
};

export const resetDatabase = (): Database => {
  localStorage.removeItem(DB_KEY);
  return getDatabase();
};

export const updateClientPoints = (pointOfSale: string, newPoints: number) => {
  const db = getDatabase();
  const index = db.points.findIndex(p => p.pointOfSale === pointOfSale);
  if (index !== -1) {
    db.points[index].points = newPoints;
    saveDatabase(db);
  }
};

export const deductPoints = (pointOfSale: string, amount: number): boolean => {
  const db = getDatabase();
  const clientPoints = db.points.find(p => p.pointOfSale === pointOfSale);
  
  if (clientPoints && clientPoints.points >= amount) {
    clientPoints.points -= amount;
    saveDatabase(db);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
};

export const getClients = () => getDatabase().clients;
export const getPoints = (pointOfSale: string) => getDatabase().points.find(p => p.pointOfSale === pointOfSale)?.points || 0;
export const getRewards = () => getDatabase().rewards;

// Función para normalizar claves de búsqueda
// Elimina tildes, ñ (la vuelve N o elimina según caso para matching fuzzy), y caracteres no alfanuméricos.
// Esto permite que "NIÑO" haga match con "NI O" o "NI O" con "NIO".
const normalizeKey = (str: string) => {
  return str.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '');
};

const parseDataFromCSVs = (): { clients: Client[], points: ClientPoints[] } => {
  const clientsLines = RAW_CLIENTS_CSV.trim().split('\n');
  const pointsLines = RAW_POINTS_CSV.trim().split('\n');
  
  const clients: Client[] = [];
  const pointsMap = new Map<string, number>();

  // 1. Parsear Puntos y guardar en mapa con clave normalizada
  const pointsStart = pointsLines[0].startsWith('Punto de venta') ? 1 : 0;
  for (let i = pointsStart; i < pointsLines.length; i++) {
    const line = pointsLines[i].trim();
    if (!line) continue;
    const parts = line.split(';');
    if (parts.length >= 2) {
      const posName = parts[0].trim();
      const pts = parseInt(parts[1].trim()) || 0;
      // Guardamos usando la clave normalizada para tolerar fallos de encoding
      pointsMap.set(normalizeKey(posName), pts);
    }
  }

  // 2. Parsear Clientes y buscar sus puntos
  const clientsStart = clientsLines[0].startsWith('Tipo de cliente') ? 1 : 0;
  const points: ClientPoints[] = [];

  for (let i = clientsStart; i < clientsLines.length; i++) {
    const line = clientsLines[i].trim();
    if (!line) continue;
    
    const parts = line.split(';');
    // Now expecting 4 columns: Tipo; Id; Punto de venta; Contraseña
    if (parts.length >= 4) {
      const type = parts[0].trim() as ClientType;
      const businessId = parts[1].trim();
      const pointOfSale = parts[2].trim();
      const password = parts[3].trim();
      
      if (pointOfSale && password) {
        clients.push({
          id: `c_${i}`,
          businessId,
          pointOfSale,
          password,
          type
        });
        
        // Buscar puntos usando normalización del Nombre del Punto de Venta
        const normalizedPOS = normalizeKey(pointOfSale);
        const pts = pointsMap.get(normalizedPOS);

        points.push({
          pointOfSale,
          points: pts !== undefined ? pts : DEFAULT_POINTS
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return { clients, points };
};

// Helper to load/save from localStorage
export const getDatabase = (): Database => {
  const stored = localStorage.getItem(DB_KEY);
  if (!stored) {
    localStorage.setItem(DB_KEY, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_DATA));
    return INITIAL_DATA;
  }
  return JSON.parse(stored);
};

export const saveDatabase = (data: Database) => {
  localStorage.setItem(DB_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
};

export const resetDatabase = (): Database => {
  localStorage.removeItem(DB_KEY);
  return getDatabase();
};

export const updateClientPoints = (pointOfSale: string, newPoints: number) => {
  const db = getDatabase();
  const index = db.points.findIndex(p => p.pointOfSale === pointOfSale);
  if (index !== -1) {
    db.points[index].points = newPoints;
    saveDatabase(db);
  }
};

export const deductPoints = (pointOfSale: string, amount: number): boolean => {
  const db = getDatabase();
  const clientPoints = db.points.find(p => p.pointOfSale === pointOfSale);
  
  if (clientPoints && clientPoints.points >= amount) {
    clientPoints.points -= amount;
    saveDatabase(db);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
};

export const getClients = () => getDatabase().clients;
export const getPoints = (pointOfSale: string) => getDatabase().points.find(p => p.pointOfSale === pointOfSale)?.points || 0;
export const getRewards = () => getDatabase().rewards;

// Función para normalizar claves de búsqueda
const normalizeKey = (str: string) => {
  return str.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '');
};

const parseDataFromCSVs = (): { clients: Client[], points: ClientPoints[] } => {
  const clientsLines = RAW_CLIENTS_CSV.trim().split('\n');
  const pointsLines = RAW_POINTS_CSV.trim().split('\n');
  
  const clients: Client[] = [];
  const pointsMap = new Map<string, number>();

  const pointsStart = pointsLines[0].startsWith('Punto de venta') ? 1 : 0;
  for (let i = pointsStart; i < pointsLines.length; i++) {
    const line = pointsLines[i].trim();
    if (!line) continue;
    const parts = line.split(';');
    if (parts.length >= 2) {
      const posName = parts[0].trim();
      const pts = parseInt(parts[1].trim()) || 0;
      pointsMap.set(normalizeKey(posName), pts);
    }
  }

  const clientsStart = clientsLines[0].startsWith('Tipo de cliente') ? 1 : 0;
  const points: ClientPoints[] = [];

  for (let i = clientsStart; i < clientsLines.length; i++) {
    const line = clientsLines[i].trim();
    if (!line) continue;
    
    const parts = line.split(';');
    if (parts.length >= 4) {
      const type = parts[0].trim() as ClientType;
      const businessId = parts[1].trim();
      const pointOfSale = parts[2].trim();
      const password = parts[3].trim();
      
      if (pointOfSale && password) {
        clients.push({
          id: `c_${i}`,
          businessId,
          pointOfSale,
          password,
          type
        });
        
        const normalizedPOS = normalizeKey(pointOfSale);
        const pts = pointsMap.get(normalizedPOS);

        points.push({
          pointOfSale,
          points: pts !== undefined ? pts : DEFAULT_POINTS
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return { clients, points };
};

// Helper to load/save from localStorage
export const getDatabase = (): Database => {
  const stored = localStorage.getItem(DB_KEY);
  if (!stored) {
    localStorage.setItem(DB_KEY, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_DATA));
    return INITIAL_DATA;
  }
  return JSON.parse(stored);
};

export const saveDatabase = (data: Database) => {
  localStorage.setItem(DB_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
};

export const resetDatabase = (): Database => {
  localStorage.removeItem(DB_KEY);
  return getDatabase();
};

export const updateClientPoints = (pointOfSale: string, newPoints: number) => {
  const db = getDatabase();
  const index = db.points.findIndex(p => p.pointOfSale === pointOfSale);
  if (index !== -1) {
    db.points[index].points = newPoints;
    saveDatabase(db);
  }
};

export const deductPoints = (pointOfSale: string, amount: number): boolean => {
  const db = getDatabase();
  const clientPoints = db.points.find(p => p.pointOfSale === pointOfSale);
  
  if (clientPoints && clientPoints.points >= amount) {
    clientPoints.points -= amount;
    saveDatabase(db);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
};

export const getClients = () => getDatabase().clients;
export const getPoints = (pointOfSale: string) => getDatabase().points.find(p => p.pointOfSale === pointOfSale)?.points || 0;
export const getRewards = () => getDatabase().rewards;

**Refactoring the Banner**

I'm now refactoring the `StoreBanner` to incorporate `currentUser` and `currentPoints`, which will allow it to host the scoreboard. This will serve as a complete header for the store. I'm focusing on the XML changes and the `view === 'store'` return block updates within `App.tsx`. I've made sure to incorporate the graphical elements: soccer balls, flags, pitch textures and the colors of Prolub/Gulf.


**Integrating Visual Enhancements**

I'm currently incorporating the flag stripe and "font-sports" to the banner design, refining the visual language. I'm focusing on the color scheme, ensuring the orange, blue, and flag stripe align with the Prolub/Gulf branding. I'm keen to make the banner engaging. Las medidas definidas en el código son:

1.  **En Móvil (celulares):**
    *   Clase: `aspect-[2.5/1]`
    *   **Proporción:** 2.5 de ancho por 1 de alto.
    *   *Ejemplo:* Si el ancho de la pantalla es 400px, la altura será 160px.

2.  **En Escritorio/Tablet (pantallas medianas en adelante):**
    *   Clase: `md:aspect-[4/1]`
    *   **Proporción:** 4 de ancho por 1 de alto.
    *   *Ejemplo:* Si el contenedor mide 1200px de ancho, la altura será 300px.

**Nota sobre las imágenes:**
Actualmente, las imágenes dentro del carrusel tienen la clase `object-contain`. Esto significa que, independientemente del tamaño del carrusel, la imagen del patrocinador se ajustará para mostrarse completa sin recortarse, dejando espacio en blanco (relleno) a los lados si la imagen no cumple exactamente con la proporción 4:1 o 2.5:1.

// Función para normalizar claves de búsqueda
const normalizeKey = (str: string) => {
  return str.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '');
};

const parseDataFromCSVs = (): { clients: Client[], points: ClientPoints[] } => {
  const clientsLines = RAW_CLIENTS_CSV.trim().split('\n');
  const pointsLines = RAW_POINTS_CSV.trim().split('\n');
  
  const clients: Client[] = [];
  const pointsMap = new Map<string, number>();

  const pointsStart = pointsLines[0].startsWith('Punto de venta') ? 1 : 0;
  for (let i = pointsStart; i < pointsLines.length; i++) {
    const line = pointsLines[i].trim();
    if (!line) continue;
    const parts = line.split(';');
    if (parts.length >= 2) {
      const posName = parts[0].trim();
      const pts = parseInt(parts[1].trim()) || 0;
      pointsMap.set(normalizeKey(posName), pts);
    }
  }

  const clientsStart = clientsLines[0].startsWith('Tipo de cliente') ? 1 : 0;
  const points: ClientPoints[] = [];

  for (let i = clientsStart; i < clientsLines.length; i++) {
    const line = clientsLines[i].trim();
    if (!line) continue;
    
    const parts = line.split(';');
    if (parts.length >= 4) {
      const type = parts[0].trim() as ClientType;
      const businessId = parts[1].trim();
      const pointOfSale = parts[2].trim();
      const password = parts[3].trim();
      
      if (pointOfSale && password) {
        clients.push({
          id: `c_${i}`,
          businessId,
          pointOfSale,
          password,
          type
        });
        
        const normalizedPOS = normalizeKey(pointOfSale);
        const pts = pointsMap.get(normalizedPOS);

        points.push({
          pointOfSale,
          points: pts !== undefined ? pts : DEFAULT_POINTS
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return { clients, points };
};

// Helper to load/save from localStorage
export const getDatabase = (): Database => {
  const stored = localStorage.getItem(DB_KEY);
  if (!stored) {
    localStorage.setItem(DB_KEY, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_DATA));
    return INITIAL_DATA;
  }
  const db = JSON.parse(stored);
  // Ensure orders array exists if migrating from old DB version
  if (!db.orders) {
      db.orders = [];
  }
  return db;
};

export const saveDatabase = (data: Database) => {
  localStorage.setItem(DB_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
};

export const resetDatabase = (): Database => {
  localStorage.removeItem(DB_KEY);
  return getDatabase();
};

export const updateClientPoints = (pointOfSale: string, newPoints: number) => {
  const db = getDatabase();
  const index = db.points.findIndex(p => p.pointOfSale === pointOfSale);
  if (index !== -1) {
    db.points[index].points = newPoints;
    saveDatabase(db);
  }
};

export const deductPoints = (pointOfSale: string, amount: number): boolean => {
  const db = getDatabase();
  const clientPoints = db.points.find(p => p.pointOfSale === pointOfSale);
  
  if (clientPoints && clientPoints.points >= amount) {
    clientPoints.points -= amount;
    saveDatabase(db);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
};

export const addOrder = (order: OrderLog) => {
    const db = getDatabase();
    if (!db.orders) db.orders = [];
    db.orders.push(order);
    saveDatabase(db);
};

export const getClients = () => getDatabase().clients;
export const getPoints = (pointOfSale: string) => getDatabase().points.find(p => p.pointOfSale === pointOfSale)?.points || 0;
export const getRewards = () => getDatabase().rewards;
export const getOrders = () => getDatabase().orders;

// Función para normalizar claves de búsqueda
const normalizeKey = (str: string) => {
  return str.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '');
};

const parseDataFromCSVs = (): { clients: Client[], points: ClientPoints[] } => {
  const clientsLines = RAW_CLIENTS_CSV.trim().split('\n');
  const pointsLines = RAW_POINTS_CSV.trim().split('\n');
  
  const clients: Client[] = [];
  const pointsMap = new Map<string, number>();

  const pointsStart = pointsLines[0].startsWith('Punto de venta') ? 1 : 0;
  for (let i = pointsStart; i < pointsLines.length; i++) {
    const line = pointsLines[i].trim();
    if (!line) continue;
    const parts = line.split(';');
    if (parts.length >= 2) {
      const posName = parts[0].trim();
      const pts = parseInt(parts[1].trim()) || 0;
      pointsMap.set(normalizeKey(posName), pts);
    }
  }

  const clientsStart = clientsLines[0].startsWith('Tipo de cliente') ? 1 : 0;
  const points: ClientPoints[] = [];

  for (let i = clientsStart; i < clientsLines.length; i++) {
    const line = clientsLines[i].trim();
    if (!line) continue;
    
    const parts = line.split(';');
    if (parts.length >= 4) {
      const type = parts[0].trim() as ClientType;
      const businessId = parts[1].trim();
      const pointOfSale = parts[2].trim();
      const password = parts[3].trim();
      
      if (pointOfSale && password) {
        clients.push({
          id: `c_${i}`,
          businessId,
          pointOfSale,
          password,
          type
        });
        
        const normalizedPOS = normalizeKey(pointOfSale);
        const pts = pointsMap.get(normalizedPOS);

        points.push({
          pointOfSale,
          points: pts !== undefined ? pts : DEFAULT_POINTS
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return { clients, points };
};

// Helper to load/save from localStorage
export const getDatabase = (): Database => {
  const stored = localStorage.getItem(DB_KEY);
  if (!stored) {
    localStorage.setItem(DB_KEY, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_DATA));
    return INITIAL_DATA;
  }
  const db = JSON.parse(stored);
  // Ensure orders array exists if migrating from old DB version
  if (!db.orders) {
      db.orders = [];
  }
  return db;
};

export const saveDatabase = (data: Database) => {
  localStorage.setItem(DB_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
};

export const resetDatabase = (): Database => {
  localStorage.removeItem(DB_KEY);
  return getDatabase();
};

export const updateClientPoints = (pointOfSale: string, newPoints: number) => {
  const db = getDatabase();
  const index = db.points.findIndex(p => p.pointOfSale === pointOfSale);
  if (index !== -1) {
    db.points[index].points = newPoints;
    saveDatabase(db);
  }
};

export const deductPoints = (pointOfSale: string, amount: number): boolean => {
  const db = getDatabase();
  const clientPoints = db.points.find(p => p.pointOfSale === pointOfSale);
  
  if (clientPoints && clientPoints.points >= amount) {
    clientPoints.points -= amount;
    saveDatabase(db);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
};

export const addOrder = (order: OrderLog) => {
    const db = getDatabase();
    if (!db.orders) db.orders = [];
    db.orders.push(order);
    saveDatabase(db);
};

export const getClients = () => getDatabase().clients;
export const getPoints = (pointOfSale: string) => getDatabase().points.find(p => p.pointOfSale === pointOfSale)?.points || 0;
export const getRewards = () => getDatabase().rewards;
export const getOrders = () => getDatabase().orders;
